why: The four shapes a real lead takes in a hiring thread. Each is a live
advert from the September 2026 thread, trimmed but not reworded, so the
gate is graded against what companies actually write rather than what
the rules were designed to catch.

cases.why: The clearest possible lead: remote, contract, an hourly rate and a start date. If this ever stops scoring buyer the rule set is broken.

record.text: Noricum | Senior Backend Engineer, Payments, Ledger | REMOTE (2h overlap with US Pacific) | Contract to permanent | $120-160/hr | Start by 14 Sep. I'm the founder of Noricum where we build the ledger and payment rails behind a product. Python, Postgres, API integration work.

cases.why: Fractional with the hours written down is the offer's exact shape - an engineer inside the client's team, not a full-time hire.

record.text: We The Flywheel | AI-Native Engineers & Operators | REMOTE (worldwide) | Contract / Part-time (10-40 hrs/wk). We're a remote-first digital product studio with deeply AI-native workflows and automation across 500+ web properties. Paid hourly.

cases.why: A company open to either is still a buyer: the contract door is open, which is all the offer needs.

record.text: Catalyst | Agent Builder | Remote (US ET Overlap) | Full-time / Part-time / Contract | We build LLM agents and automation for internal tools. $90-120/hr depending on experience.

cases.why: "Full-time contractor" reads as full-time and is not: it is a contract engagement at full-time hours, and it pays hourly. Pinned because the words argue with each other.

record.text: Search Atlas | Product Engineer | REMOTE (anywhere, EST hours) | Full-time contractor | $23-$34 USD/hour. We're ~160 people building SEO automation tooling in Python and TypeScript.

cases.why: ODK: "Senior Product Manager | Remote (Worldwide) | Long-term contract, 30-40 hours/week | $90-110/hr" was REJECTED for "never says what work it needs done", because our_work only listed AI and automation words. The offer is an engineer in the client's team, not an AI consultancy. Nine of seventeen rejected contract-and-remote adverts failed this way.

record.text: ODK | Senior Product Manager | Remote (Worldwide) | Long-term contract, 30-40 hours/week | $90-110/hour USD. ODK is an open-source platform used to collect billions of data points for disease surveillance and supply chain traceability.

cases.why: Lopaka: "Embedded UI / Graphics Engineer | REMOTE | Contract | Part-time | $80-140/hr" is as clear a lead as the sample contains and mentions none of AI, automation or integration.

record.text: Lopaka | Embedded UI / Graphics Engineer | REMOTE | Contract | Part-time | $80-140/hr | We build a graphics library for embedded displays in C++.
